exposure: women incontinent at 4 and continent at 12 years
women continent at 4 and incontinent at 12 years
women continent 4 and 12 years after first delivery
cohort: 236 women who gave birth in 1996 in two French maternity units at term
finding: Factors associated with UI 12 years after first pregnancy were BMI, increasing BMI, first child's weight, and UI during first pregnancy.
mod_finding: This study found that urinary incontinence during the first pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of urinary incontinence 12 years postpartum.
